figurative_meaning_en: a faint or soft sound, implying complete silence
similar_in_english: you could hear a pin drop
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরে চুঁ শব্দও শোনা যাচ্ছে না।
সভায় চুঁ শব্দের স্তব্ধতা নেমে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There isn't even a faint sound in the room.
A pin-drop silence fell over the meeting.
note: This idiom uses onomatopoeia to mimic a very soft sound, commonly used to emphasize utter quietness in Bengali speech.
